mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing allopurinol metabolism via xanthine oxidase, while also having mild antiplatelet properties that could theoretically enhance bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for reduced allopurinol efficacy (elevated uric acid levels) and assess bleeding signs; consider spacing administration or monitoring serum uric acid more frequently if combined.
